notes: Vine Street runs along the plate's east edge and is partly cut by it; its centre is taken about 45 px (half of 60 ft) east of the west lot line, close to the car-track line. Kessler x Mitchell: north arm is a short unnamed stub (20 in. sewer) cut by the plate edge, roughly in line with Kessler. Names cut by the plate edge: 'CLIN.. SPRI..' east of Vine (written Clinton Springs Avenue, suffix not visible; its centre sits about 70 px south of Clinton Springs Lane), 'GLENW..' (written Glenwood Avenue), 'EHRMA..' (written Ehrman Avenue). Ringwalt Avenue: name printed west of the strip (about x 6400, y 3000); only 'AVE.' is printed on the leg at x 8150, y 2680. Greendale Avenue name printed about x 5700, y 6230; Woolper name printed about x 5800, y 6840 (only 'AVENUE' printed near x 7850). '?' at 8507,6881 is an unnamed stub east of Vine (8 in. W. pipe), offset south of Woolper. Juergens Avenue ends at Lauk Avenue. Not picked as streets: the unnamed strips of cemetery ground from the south end of Kessler east along the curved boundary and north-east to the Parkwood Place circle (between cemetery lots 6 and 8), and the 10 ft 'G.E.P. Cemetery Ass'n' strip from Frank Court to Vine at y 2610. Frank Court (15 ft) meets no street. 'East Clifton' is a subdivision name.
